description: Manages system-wide configuration settings and application parameters.

endpoints.name: Get
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current system-wide configuration settings. This endpoint provides read-only access to various application parameters and environmental configurations.
example_uses: How do I get the current application configuration?
Show me all the system settings.
Retrieve the configuration details for the application.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to fetch the global configuration settings of the application, such as API keys, feature flags, or environmental variables. This is typically used for read-only access to system parameters.
